Sometimes we need to know how long it takes to solve a problem. We want to know how run time changes if the size of the problem increases. There are two ways complexity can be measured: in time or space.
## Benchmarking
---
- Picked some desired inpout
- Actually run implementation
- Measure time and space needed.
## Asymptotic Analysis
---
Focuses more on how a value changes when `n`, the input size, increases. It is a way to mathematically analyze efficiency. If we want time calculated as a function of size, we do the following:
- Remove constant factors
- Remove lower order terms
- Use "Big O" notation
	- T --> O(f(n))
